definitions.explanation: A mechanical fan used to remove stale air, smoke, or odors from a room.

examples.japanese: {料理|りょうり}をする{時|とき}は{換気扇|かんきせん}をつけてください。
examples.english: Please turn on the exhaust fan when cooking.

examples.japanese: {換気扇|かんきせん}が{油|あぶら}で{汚|よご}れている。
examples.english: The ventilation fan is dirty with grease.

examples.japanese: {浴室|よくしつ}の{換気扇|かんきせん}を{回|まわ}しておく。
examples.english: Leave the bathroom exhaust fan running.

notes:
{換気扇|かんきせん} is a compound: {換気|かんき} (ventilation) + {扇|せん} (fan).

COMMON LOCATIONS:
- {台所|だいどころ}の{換気扇|かんきせん} (kitchen exhaust fan)
- {浴室|よくしつ}の{換気扇|かんきせん} (bathroom exhaust fan)
- トイレの{換気扇|かんきせん} (toilet exhaust fan)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {換気扇|かんきせん}をつける/つけておく (to turn on the fan)
- {換気扇|かんきせん}を{回|まわ}す (to run the fan)
- {換気扇|かんきせん}を{掃除|そうじ}する (to clean the fan)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Kitchen exhaust fans in Japan commonly get very greasy and require regular cleaning. Many people clean them during {大掃除|おおそうじ} (year-end cleaning).
